name: pagerduty
description: Triage incidents, manage services and on-call, and automate PagerDuty workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Incidents, services, escalation policies, and on-call schedules.
interface.longDescription: Work with PagerDuty from Caeros: triage and resolve incidents (acknowledge, reassign, add notes and status updates), manage services, escalation policies, and on-call schedules, and run clean postmortems. Connects to PagerDuty's official hosted MCP server (mcp.pagerduty.com) exposing 60+ tools across incidents, services, on-call, escalation, event orchestration, and status pages, authenticated with your own PagerDuty account.
defaultPrompt: Who is on call right now for my services, and what changes tonight?
Summarize all open PagerDuty incidents and suggest a triage order
Draft a postmortem timeline from last night's P1 incident
